title: Weighted-threshold Coupon Collection
summary: We study a weighted-threshold version of the coupon collector problem in continuous time. Each type $i$ is discovered at rate $λp_i$ and, once discovered, contributes weight $w_i$, where $p$ and $w$ are probability vectors. The stopping time when the total weight of the discovered types first exceeds a fixed threshold $θ\in (0,1)$ is called the quorum time. We first prove concentration estimates and compare the quorum time with the corresponding deterministic threshold time obtained from the mean discovered weight.
